description: Unofficial desktop app for Vaultwarden and Bitwarden vaults: a quick-access popup plus a full vault window, with browser-extension pairing.
notes: Every desktop build is published as a GitHub pre-release, so 'releases/latest' is always 404 here; 'checkver' reads the releases API list instead, filtered to the 'v<version>' tag family so the separately released browser extension tags cannot win.
Do not point 'checkver' at releases.atom: that feed also lists draft releases, which publish no downloadable assets.
Windows x64 only (no arm64 build) and the bundles are unsigned previews, so Windows may warn on first run. The installer requires Windows 11.
Vault and session data live in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Boltwarden, not in the install directory: the ZIP is not a portable vault, 'persist' does not apply, and uninstalling leaves that data behind.
Quit Boltwarden before upgrading or uninstalling - it holds files in its install directory, and upstream's own installer runs 'boltwarden quit' before replacing them.
boltwarden-native-host.exe is the browser native-messaging host and must stay beside boltwarden.exe; it is not shimmed.
